ZU.CLAIM_TOPUP_DESC: Sami ƙarin ZU {{amount}} don ci gaba da ƙirƙira. Sau ɗaya a rana.
ZU.TOPUP_CLAIMED: An riga an ɗauki ƙarin yau
ZU.COST_IN_APP_CHAT: Hira ta AI a cikin app (ZypparBot)
ZU.FOOTNOTE_ALLOWANCE: Mintuna 30 na farko na bincike kowace rana kyauta ne. Alawus ɗin ku na yau da kullum ya haɗa da app — ba mu caje fiye da iyaka ba. Wallafofi na hannu ba sa cin ZU kuma suna samun +2 ZU idan na jama'a ne.
ZU.FREE_CHAT_DESC: Grok/DeepSeek a cikin app suna amfani da API da ZU ɗinku. Hirarsu ta kyauta a browser ba ta cin ZU. Buɗe kowane lokaci (babu ƙwaƙwalwar bayanan Zyppar).
ZU.LOAD_ERROR: An kasa lodin matsayin ZU. Duba haɗin ku sake gwadawa.
ZU.STATUS_HEALTHY: Kuna cikin yanayi mai kyau don ƙirƙirar AI yau.
ZU.STATUS_WARNING: ZU na ƙarewa — ajiye don samarwa, ko yi amfani da hira ta browser kyauta.
ZU.STATUS_CRITICAL: ZU kusan ƙare. Wallafa ga jama'a (+2) ko jira sake farawa.
ZU.STATUS_EXHAUSTED: ZU na yau sun ƙare. Wallafa jama'a (+2 ZU), nemi ƙari, ko hira kyauta a browser.
ZU.EARN_POST: Wallafa wadda ba ta sirri ba → +{{n}} ZU nan take
ZU.EARN_CREATOR: Wallafofi {{current}}/{{needed}} na jama'a wannan wata → buɗe Mahalicci ({{creatorLimit}} ZU/rana)
ZU.EARN_CREATOR_DONE: An buɗe Mahalicci — {{limit}} ZU kowace rana
ZU.TIPS_TITLE: Ajiye ZU · ci gaba da samarwa
ZU.TIP_MANUAL: Wallafofi na murya/rubutu da hannu ba sa cin ZU.
ZU.TIP_PUBLIC: Wallafofi na jama'a suna samun +{{n}} ZU kuma suna ƙidaya zuwa matakin Mahalicci.
ZU.TIP_FREE_CHAT: Hira mara iyaka ta Grok/DeepSeek: hanyoyin browser kyauta (babu ZU).
ZU.TIP_INCLUDED: ZU ɗinku na yau da kullum alawus ne da aka haɗa — ba caji fiye da iyaka ba.
ZU.RESETS_LOCAL: Yana sake farawa tsakar dare (your time)
ZU.INCLUDED_ALLOWANCE: Alawus ɗin rana da aka haɗa
ZU.MAX_MONTHLY_SUB: If you use your full daily ZU every day for {{days}} days — not a bill, the ceiling of included value.
ZU.MAX_MONTHLY_NOTE: Manual posts are free; public posts earn +2 ZU. Free browser AI chat uses no ZU.
ZU.AI_FRIENDLY_NOTE: AI uses your region (country, language, culture) so answers feel local, friendly, and transparent.

loopkeeper.reminders.title: Tunatarwa da bibiya
loopkeeper.reminders.empty: Babu abin da aka tsara tukuna — yi amfani da fom ɗin sama don saita tunatarwarka ta farko.
loopkeeper.reminders.chooseContactMsg: Pick who this reminder is for.
loopkeeper.billing.title: Biyan kuɗi
loopkeeper.billing.trialSuffix: — kyauta har sai madaukanka na farko sun rufe.
loopkeeper.billing.featBasic1: Muhimman abubuwa: katunan mutanen da suka shafe ka, bibiya, da tunatarwa ɗaya mai kyau
loopkeeper.billing.featBasic2: Daidaitawa (cloud / LoopKeeper server), pods, hira cikin app
loopkeeper.billing.featBasic3: tunatarwa biyar a wata — isa don share abin da ke kan ka
loopkeeper.billing.featAssistant2: Mataimakin yana aiki duk wata — kowane madauki buɗe ana kama shi
loopkeeper.billing.featAssistant3: AI yana rubuta saƙon da kake jinkirtawa — kai ka danna Aika
loopkeeper.billing.featAssistant4: Jagororin tattaunawa masu wuya · shawarwarin bibiya da lokaci
loopkeeper.billing.gatewayMissing: {{ gateway }} ba a haɗa shi ba tukuna — zaɓi wata hanyar biya a sama.
loopkeeper.billing.privacy: Babu buƙatar lambar waya ko asali don amfani da LoopKeeper. Mai sarrafa biyan kuɗi yana riƙe bayanan biyanka don rasit kawai.
loopkeeper.billing.footnote: Biyan kuɗi ta Stripe · Paystack · Flutterwave · Paddle. Kana iya soke kowane lokaci a wannan allon.
loopkeeper.ai.title: Mataimakin AI
loopkeeper.ai.intro: Zaɓi injin AI ɗin da LoopKeeper ke amfani da shi
loopkeeper.ai.intro2: don mataimaki. Abokan hulɗarka suna nan inda ka ajiye su — Na'ura, Cloud, ko LoopKeeper Server.
loopkeeper.ai.noteKeys: Maɓallan injin suna a kan LoopKeeper server, ba a cikin app ba. Idan maɓalli ya ɓace, app yana amfani da injin na'ura.
loopkeeper.ai.saved: An ajiye. Mataimakin yanzu yana bayarwa ta {{ provider }}.
loopkeeper.ai.nudgesLeft: {{ n }} daga cikin 5 tunatarwa sun rage a wannan watan
loopkeeper.ai.upgrade: Haɓaka zuwa Mataimaki ($5/wata) a Biyan kuɗi don AI ya yi aiki duk wata.
loopkeeper.privacy.title: Sirri
loopkeeper.privacy.headline: Bayanan naka naka ne.
loopkeeper.privacy.subhead: Babu bin abokan hulɗa, babu siyar da abokan hulɗa, babu kwafin cloud sai ka zaɓa.
loopkeeper.privacy.pledgeBody: Babu buƙatar lambar waya, imel, ko asali don amfani da LoopKeeper. Duk abin da ka raba na son rai ne. Ba mu tattara bayanan sirri ba — ko da AI na waje ko bincike ya dube mu, babu ma'ajin asali da za a samu.
loopkeeper.privacy.deviceBody: Katunanka, rubutanka da mahallin 4-W suna cikin ƙwaƙwalwar na'urarka. Ba sa barin na'urar sai ka zaɓi daidaitawa ko rabawa.
loopkeeper.privacy.lockBody: PIN na zaɓi a lokacin buɗewa. PIN an hashed SHA-256 a na'ura — ba a taɓa aikawa ba. Idan ka manta, kawai hanyar ita ce share bayanan app / sake sakawa.
loopkeeper.privacy.cloudBody: Lokacin da ka tura zuwa Dropbox, Drive ko OneDrive, an ɓoye fakitin da kalmar sirrinka kafin ya bar na'urar. Mai ba da sabis yana ganin rubutun ɓoye kawai.
loopkeeper.privacy.shareBody: Gayyatar tana raba lokacin da ka zaɓa don aikawa kawai. Ragowar katin ya kasance sirri — LoopKeeper yana amfani da mahallinka a gida, ba kamar bayanan jama'a ba.
loopkeeper.help.title: Tambayoyi & Taimako
loopkeeper.about.noSnapshot: Babu hoton da ya gabata tukuna. Rufe wannan portal sau ɗaya — wannan ya zama tushenka — sannan ziyararka ta gaba za ta nuna abin da ya canza.
loopkeeper.help.headline: Mutanenka, an kiyaye su daidai.
loopkeeper.help.subhead: Duk abin da ke ƙasa yana cikin wannan app — danna Go akan kowane fasalin don tsallakewa.
loopkeeper.help.footer: An gina shi a kan na'urarka da farko — sannan Cloud ko LoopKeeper Server, zaɓinka.
